claims.claim: At OpenAI DevDay on September 29, 2026, OpenAI launched 'Dots', persistent 24/7 autonomous personal AI agents operating inside secure cloud environments.
claims.notes: Verified primary launch announcement at DevDay San Francisco.

claims.claim: Dots run continuously in the background to automate cross-application workflows including Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, travel, and budgeting.
claims.notes: Persistent agentic execution beyond single-prompt interactions.

claims.claim: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol, delivering Astra-tier coding and agentic computer use capabilities at approximately one-fifth (20%) of the token cost.
claims.notes: Cost-optimized frontier reasoning model with hardened instruction-following.

claims.claim: Dots roll out to ChatGPT Pro 200 and Business Premium tiers, operating with verified permission scopes to prevent unauthorized actions.
claims.notes: Addresses the scope authorization challenges highlighted by earlier Astra evals.

editorial_cautions: Clarify that GPT-6.1 Sol is shipping commercially, whereas GPT-6.1 Astra remains held in research.
Highlight the transition from reactive chatbots to persistent 24/7 background agents.
